request.query: Expand a multivariate polynomial P in Option variables of degreeOf none at most n as sum range n+1 of X none powers times rename some coefficient polynomials

items.name: Polynomial.as_sum_range_C_mul_X_pow
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R),
  p = ∑ i ∈ Finset.range (p.natDegree + 1), Polynomial.C (p.coeff i) * Polynomial.X ^ i

items.name: Polynomial.sum_C_mul_X_pow_eq
items.type: ∀ {R : Type u} [inst : Semiring R] (p : Polynomial R), (p.sum fun n a => Polynomial.C a * Polynomial.X ^ n) = p

items.name: Polynomial.expand_eq_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] (p : ℕ) {f : Polynomial R},
  (Polynomial.expand R p) f = f.sum fun e a => Polynomial.C a * (Polynomial.X ^ p) ^ e

items.name: MvPolynomial.finSuccEquiv
items.type:
(R : Type u) →
  [inst : CommSemiring R] → (n : ℕ) → MvPolynomial (Fin (n + 1)) R ≃ₐ[R] Polynomial (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)

items.name: MvPowerSeries.truncFun'
items.type:
{σ : Type u_1} →
  {R : Type u_2} → [DecidableEq σ] → [inst : CommSemiring R] → (σ →₀ ℕ) → MvPowerSeries σ R → MvPolynomial σ R
